_doc: Reputation and the title ceremony (GDD 4.12.1, 4.12.2, ap. A; docs/contratos/h9_titulos.md) [balance]. Offices and elections come with H10.

reputation._doc: classes: the social classes of the class modifier (family.class_reputation, GDD 4.12.1: reputation with a class = reputation + class_reputation[class]). class_share: a change with a class also moves that class's modifier by round(amount x class_share). reason_class: the class of the changes other systems make (Reputation.change reasons). log_size: changes kept in family.reputation_log. rules: what the events of a step give (Reputation.step): events (event types), amount (global), class ("target" = the other one's class: the counter's customer or the townsperson; an id; null), class_amount, cap / cap_days (at most cap times per window of cap_days days; 0 = no cap), min_quality (sales), action and ok (npc_action). passive: per_business_with_staff, at dawn, for each operative workshop of the family with an active employee (ap. A).

ceremony._doc: GDD 4.12.2: the request is made in person at the town hall (the map's town_hall service tile); the gold is paid and the requirements checked; the first holder of approvers (an office of H10) approves if its affinity with the actor is >= min_affinity; a vacant office (no holder: all of them until H10) approves by itself.
